flows.title: Generate post text with AI Assist
steps: AI Assist is activated once you are on the Business Plan, or after you connect your OpenAI account.
Go to the Create page and click on the AI Assist button.
The AI Assistant will open as a chat window on the left side of your composer and remains visible as you work.
Write a detailed prompt, and click the blue button with the arrow to generate text.
If the result doesn't meet your needs, simply enter a new prompt to generate a better one.
If the result looks good to you, just click Insert to add it to your post.
The highlighted text generated by AI will be added to your post, where you can make any last minute changes and schedule it accordingly.

For a better result, specify the tone of voice, which channel the content is for, the goal for the post, the language you want the output to be in, and small details such as three trending hashtags or some emojis.
